title: Correctness of the Jacobi algorithm
statement: Let $z$ be a finite bit string whose second decoded component represents an odd integer. The output of the Jacobi algorithm on $z$ is the binary representation of one plus the Jacobi symbol of the integers represented by the first and second decoded components of $z$.
hypotheses_covered: The integer represented by the second decoded component of $z$ is odd
